title: Redbrand Hideout · Area 4 · Crypt

sourceRecords.title: 11 · Crypt · area 4
read: Three old stone coffins stand in a dusty crypt. Human skeletons in rusted armor are propped against them, and copper-covered double doors wait at the far end.

The stonework muffles the noise from elsewhere in the hideout, making a small movement feel unusually loud. The resting places and scattered remains offer different things to examine. You can leave them undisturbed, look for names or damage, or keep watch while another person searches.

brief: Dusty Tresendar family crypt, THREE stone sarcophagi, lids carved with two noble human men and one noble human woman. A human skeleton in scraps of rusty mail rests motionless against EACH coffin. Faux wall columns shaped as spreading oak trees. Tarnished copper double doors in southeast corner. Oil-lamp illumination. No standing attacking skeletons yet, no open tombs, rings or new magical effects.
